metaDescription: Scottish Deerhound vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Scottish Deerhound boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Scottish Deerhounds: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Scottish Deerhound series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class giant does not invent new viruses for the Scottish Deerhound, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag bloat (gdv) at Scottish Deerhound vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Scottish Deerhound series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Scottish Deerhound misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Scottish Deerhound series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Scottish Deerhound is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Scottish Deerhound away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Scottish Deerhound due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Scottish Deerhound core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Scottish Deerhound misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Scottish Deerhound health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Scottish Deerhound adult health guide for breed predispositions such as osteosarcoma risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
